title: Mummy Pig at Work
hook: 妈妈在家用电脑赶重要的工作，Peppa 和 George 却很想帮忙——结果帮了倒忙。

cells.a: She was working on her computer at home.

cells.q: Why could Mummy Pig not play?
cells.a: Because she had a lot of important work to do.
cells.cn: 因为她有很多重要的工作要做。

cells.q: What did the children love to do?
cells.a: They loved to watch Mummy work on the computer.
cells.cn: 他们喜欢看妈妈在电脑上工作。

cells.q: What did Mummy Pig tell George?
cells.a: She told him, “You mustn't do this.”
cells.cn: 她告诉 George：“这个不能乱动。”

cells.a: It went wrong. It was not meant to do that.
cells.cn: 电脑出问题了，本来不该这样。

cells.a: He said he was not very good with these things.
cells.cn: 他说自己不太会弄这些东西。

cells.a: He mended the computer for Mummy Pig.

cells.q: What did Daddy Pig tell Peppa?
cells.a: He said, “Maybe you should ask Mummy Pig.”
cells.cn: 他说：“也许你该问问妈妈。”

cells.q: What did Mummy Pig say at the end?
cells.a: She came in and asked, “What on earth is going on?”
cells.cn: 她走进来问：“到底发生什么事了？”

helper.order: First / Next / Then / After that / Finally

opener: Today I watched Peppa Pig. This episode is “Mummy Pig at Work”.
ending: In the end, Mummy Pig comes in and asks what is going on. My favourite part is ______.
